name: What should I consider before converting my garage into an in-law suite?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before converting my garage into an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before converting your garage into an in-law suite, you should consider several factors: structural integrity, insulation, utility access (plumbing, electrical), and local zoning regulations regarding garage conversions. You'll also need to decide on the extent of the conversion, from a simple bedroom/bathroom to a full living space with a kitchen. As a preparation step, Hometelligent Inc. advises clients in Fremont or Hayward to research their city's specific ADU regulations for garage conversions, as these can vary and impact design possibilities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before converting a garage to an in-law suite, consider structural needs, insulation, utility access, and local zoning. Research specific city ADU regulations for garage conversions.
